people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
translations.bsb: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”
translations.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
translations.asv: Fear not, daughter of Zion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
